captions.detailed: This is a task lamp featuring a desk clamp base, a single long arm, a short connector link, and a flat LED bar head. The entire assembly is rendered in a uniform dark gray or black matte material. The desk clamp secures the lamp to a surface, above which a revolute joint allows the long arm to tilt up and down. A second revolute joint connects the long arm to the short head link, and a third joint allows the flat LED bar head to tilt independently for precise lighting control.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a modern drawing-table task lamp with a desk clamp base. The lamp should consist of a clamping base, a single long extending arm, a short head connector link, and a flat rectangular LED bar head, connected sequentially by revolute joints to allow realistic tilting articulation. Use a sleek, uniform dark grey matte material for all parts.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by defining four main parts: base (the desk clamp), arm, head_link, and head (the LED bar). Each part is modeled by combining basic box shapes using CadQuery. A series of revolute joints are declared: 'base_to_arm' connecting the clamp to the long arm, 'arm_to_head_link' connecting the long arm to the short intermediate link, and 'head_link_to_head' allowing the flat LED bar to rotate at the tip. Precise Origin offsets and rotation axes are configured for each joint to establish proper mechanical articulation.
